posts.title: The Long Shadow
posts.description: In the mid-1960s, UCLA 's basketball team was in the middle of one of the greatest runs in sport: ten national titles in twelve years. Franklin Adler , the team's student manager, saw something he never forgot. posts.title: Build People
posts.description: In 1952, Les Schwab bought a small tyre store in Prineville, Oregon. He knew very little about tyres. What he did know, or came to learn quickly, was that the business would only grow as fast as the people inside it. posts.title: The Art of Listening
posts.description: Warren Buffett was once asked about the management fads that seem to sweep through business schools and boardrooms every few years.
